facts.text: I want to come up with a name for a newly discovered physical element.
I want the name to reflect the word "uber".
I want the name to reflect Chewbacca.
I want the name to reflect leetspeak.
I want the name to have a high Scrabble value.
I want the name to include X's and Z's because they have good Scrabble value.
I think "ex" does not sound like "chew" at all.
I want a creative name that is at least 8 syllables.
